question.question:
A fictional loan has balance 36500 USD at the start of month 1 and a payment of 740 USD per month. Its annual nominal rate is 350 basis points; the regular monthly rate is that annual rate divided by 12. A payment holiday covers months 1 and 2: no payments, and deferral interest accrues at 0.5 percent per month on the month-1 opening balance only, uncompounded. At the end of month 2 the accrued deferral interest plus a one-time fee of 25 USD is capitalized once into the balance. From month 3 the original payment resumes at month end; each month adds interest at the regular monthly rate on the opening balance, then subtracts the payment. Report the regular monthly rate in percent, the capitalized amount, and the balances after the first and after the 3th resumed payment.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Regular monthly rate in percentage points, converted from annual basis points
Uncompounded two-month deferral interest plus fee added to the balance once
Balance after the first resumed month-end payment following capitalization
